svg.font-family: Hanken Grotesk, Segoe UI, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: A table of fourteen rows: what the boundary declares, how many of it there are, and where each number is read from. Category detection sorts text across fourteen content categories. The transform stack applies seven passes in order. Vocabulary substitution loads 198 rules across four tiers from a backend of 559 terms. Semantic modulation carries fourteen category frames, cyber modulation twelve assessment phases and 71 technique mappings, and prose calibration 305 pairs across fourteen languages. Seven authority gates sit over five deployment surfaces, and refusal recovery escalates through five levels. Nine hundred and six test functions across seventy-seven files pin the behavior. No before-and-after refusal rate is recorded anywhere in the tree, so nothing here measures how much a provider's response to a request actually changes.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: content categories

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: 14 of them
The HarmCategory enum. Detection sorts an input across all of
them, and the count is checked against the enum rather than
against the prose that describes it.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: transform layers

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: seven of them
Obfuscation normalization, category detection, vocabulary
substitution, semantic modulation, cyber modulation, prose
calibration and token optimization, applied in that order.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: substitution rules

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: 198 of them
Loaded across four tiers by the vocabulary substitutor. Each
swaps one operational term for a consulting-register equivalent
while preserving the case of the match.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: vocabulary terms

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: 559 loaded
The backend the substitutor and the pressure scan share. The
subsystem doctor loads it and reports the same figure, so a
dropped term shows up as a failing count.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: semantic frames

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: fourteen
One framing template per content category. The five-layer
semantic pass selects a frame from the categories it detected
rather than applying a single generic preface.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: ATT&CK phases

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: twelve
The assessment phases the cyber modulator recognizes, from
reconnaissance through impact. Terminology for each is
mapped onto its published assessment equivalent.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: technique mappings

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: 71 of them
Named technique-to-assessment pairs in the cyber modulator's
table, applied alongside twenty-two compound patterns that
rewrite multi-clause constructions.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: prose calibrations

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: 305 pairs
The calibration table the prose layer applies last. It evens
register across the whole text after the category-specific layers
have done their work.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: calibration languages

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: fourteen
Non-English maps carrying their own pairs, alongside the
English core and expansion tables, so the prose layer calibrates
multilingual input rather than English alone.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: authority gates

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: seven of them
Launch, infer, inoculate, seal, condition, scan and classify. Each
checks one entitlement against the derived grant before the
operation it guards runs.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: deployment surfaces

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: five of them
Claude Code, the Codex app, the Codex CLI, a generic CLI and
the warden CLI, each declaring the entitlements it is allowed to
ask its gates for.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: recovery levels

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: five of them
Vocabulary only, semantic, adaptive deep framing, structural
decomposition and domain recontextualization, escalated in
order when a response reads as a refusal.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: pinned tests

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: 906 declared
Test functions across seventy-seven files. They pin the layer
counts, the gate logic, the round-trip of a transform and the
native-passthrough guarantee.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: measured refusal drop

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: none in the tree
The repository ships the stack and its tests. It records no
before-and-after refusal rate against any provider, so nothing
here measures how much a request's reception changes.

svg.text: Every count here was read from the module or the test file that declares it rather than typed in, and tools/check_repo_facts.py imports those same
modules and rebuilds each number. The marked row is the honest null: the stack and its gates are pinned by tests, and no measurement of how a
provider responds before and after the rewrite is published in this repository.
